deadline.value: The Centre gives no fixed deadline. For college funding open to Indian applicants, use the President's PhD Scholarship rounds: 2 Nov 2026, 11 Jan 2027 or 1 Mar 2027 (23:59 UK time).
deadline.quote: Applicants who apply by 23:59 (UK time) 2 November 2026 and are awarded a scholarship will be notified by 31 January 2027. | Applicants who apply by 23:59 (UK time) 11 January 2027 | Applicants who apply by 23:59 (UK time) 1 March 2027

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Contact potential supervisors directly with a two-page research proposal and your CV, then complete the postgraduate application.
supervisor.quote: Prospective students should contact potential supervisors directly, outlining their research interests in a two-page research proposal and including a CV.

funding.value: You must be able to fund your studies. Some students self-fund and others hold college awards; overseas students often rely on home-country awards or UK and international bodies such as the British Council.
funding.quote: It is essential that prospective students are able to fund their studies. | overseas students may receive awards or support from organisations in their home country, or awards from UK-based and international organisations

entry_route.value: The minimum is a UK First or 2:1 bachelor's (or the country-specific equivalent) in any subject, but many studentship funders now require a relevant master's.
entry_route.quote: Students seeking admission into the Department’s PhD programme must hold as a minimum a UK First Class or UK Upper Second class bachelor’s degree or meet the country specific requirements from an accredited university. | Candidates should note, however, that many funding agencies now require applicants for PhD research studentships to have a Masters degree in a relevant subject.

notes: An interdisciplinary environmental PhD (3, occasionally 4, years) that combines natural sciences, economics, social science, law and management; recent topics include carbon capture and storage, climate finance and water scarcity. Environmental and climate science PhDs are also offered in Earth Science and Engineering, Civil and Environmental Engineering, and Physics (Space and Atmospheric Physics). Imperial's NERC SSCP DTP took its last cohort in October 2024.
